title: Parallel Prime Counter
hints: Each thread writing only `counts[t]` means no two threads touch the same number, so no mutex is needed (lesson 12.02).
Checking a big number takes longer than a small one, so the thread with the last block finishes last. Taking turns gives every thread a mix of small and big numbers.
requirements: Count the primes below N with 1, 2 and 4 `std::jthread`s
Split the work in two ways: equal blocks of numbers, and taking turns (thread i checks i, i + T, i + 2T ...)
Each thread adds to its own count; combine them after the threads finish
Print a table of the times, and explain in a comment why equal blocks are unbalanced
